div.div: One Muse Code session on the branch muse-agent, with up to 12 agents at once. The lead coordinates and is the only agent that commits; helpers explore, verify, build and check boundaries. The source of truth is the skill, .agents/skills/muse-round/ (version 6). Each round writes in its own folder, <round>/: round 1 at the top of muse-spark/, round N in muse-spark/round-<N>/.
